offering_description.value: Markets and sells branded shelf-stable and frozen packaged foods, spices and baking products to grocery chains, mass merchants and foodservice distributors across the United States. Products are made in company plants and by co-manufacturers, then sold under owned brands.

primary_products.value: canned and frozen vegetables; spices and seasonings; hot sauces; baking mixes and ingredients; cereals and hot cereals; snacks

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery chains, mass merchandisers, club stores, foodservice distributors, e-commerce retailers

end_markets.value: grocery retail; foodservice; club and mass merchandise; e-commerce

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded packaged foods sold to retailers and foodservice distributors

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and markets branded food products, sold to grocers and distributors; OEM / manufacturer: makes some products in its own plants, buys others from co-manufacturers, sold to retailers

geography_served.value: US national: United States, with smaller sales in Canada

specialization.value: related lines: shelf-stable pantry foods, frozen vegetables, snacks, spices and baking products sold through grocery channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to national grocery and mass retail chains; distributors / dealers: foodservice and grocery distributors; third-party retail: supermarkets, mass merchandisers and club stores; online: e-commerce retailers and online grocery sites; agents / brokers: sales brokers handling grocery retail accounts
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail; online; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food safety, labeling and nutrition rules, plus USDA rules for some products
